### Bible Pathway - Sept. 9, 2012
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-sept-9-2012.html
Passage: Ezekiel 29:12-15
Points:
- Egypt was once an unrivaled global superpower, yet God ended its dominance according to His sovereign timeline.
- Unlike ancient empires that were completely erased, Egypt was reduced to a lowly nation exactly as prophesied.
- God brings certain seasons of our lives to a close in order to direct us toward something new.
- Believers do not need to fear major life transitions, knowing God works through changes for our ultimate good.
- The precise fulfillment of biblical prophecy proves that God's Word is entirely trustworthy and inspired by the Holy Spirit.
